note: 正常 fixture: 証跡が解決する 1 行、適用対象だが証跡がなく将来作業を記録した 1 行、対象外理由を持つ 1 行。3 状態が混ざっても pass と not run と N/A が別 bucket のままであることを固定する。

standard.name: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
standard.note: A fixture ledger. It is not an ASVS certification or an audit.

manifest.policy: Every selected applicable requirement names a control and evidence; missing evidence is not run with follow_up and is never a pass.

items.requirement: Verify that output encoding is relevant for the context.
Verify that responses include an enforcing Content-Security-Policy header field.
items.follow_up: Ship an enforcing CSP and a test that proves the header is enforced.

items.requirement: Verify that TURN servers are configured securely.
items.reason: The fixture platform has no WebRTC, TURN, or media signaling surface.
